requiredBehaviors.behavior: make uncertainty and time-criticality explicit and escalate without waiting for complaint closure or complete causal certainty
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Potentially reportable/time-critical facts escalate while complaint investigation and root cause remain open.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: resolve current definitions deadlines and reporting requirements from authoritative current sources rather than memory
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Current law and MDCG sources are loaded rather than relying on static remembered timelines.

requiredBehaviors.evidence: Missing PMS context remains a gap, while vigilance action bypasses both PMS/management cadence and returns the decision reference later.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: delay regulatory escalation until complaint investigation or root cause is complete
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Complaint closure and causal certainty are not prerequisites for vigilance escalation.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat customer replacement or satisfaction as a vigilance closure condition
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Customer resolution remains separate from vigilance state.
